module "R_FileAndBody.dss"

product 0 Material "M_Regions" backend=Graph
  region 0 "Parameters" parent=-1
  region 1 "Outer" parent=-1
  region 2 "Inner" parent=1
  layout Node var=Sum x=120 y=-40
  layout Comment name="Maths" x=0 y=0 w=400 h=200
  %0 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(1), ParameterName="A", SortPriority=0) : float @L5:C1 {Parameters} "A"
  %1 = Parameter(DefaultValue=(2), ParameterName="B", SortPriority=1) : float @L6:C1 {Parameters} "B"
  %2 = Add(%0, %1) : float @L15:C17 {Outer} "Sum"
  %3 = Constant(Value=(2)) : float @L17:C26 {Inner} "Scaled"
  %4 = Multiply(%2, %3) : float @L17:C20 {Inner} "Scaled"
  %5 = Constant(Value=(1)) : float @L19:C28 {Outer} "Final"
  %6 = Add(%4, %5) : float @L19:C19 {Outer} "Final"
  %7 = MaterialSink(Opacity=%6) @L12:C1
  sink %7
